title: With suspension looming, Falcons list James Pearce Jr. as third-stringer

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: With suspension looming, Falcons list James Pearce Jr. as third-stringer
sources.description: Falcons defensive end James Pearce Jr., who entered a diversion program earlier this year to resolve multiple felonies arising from a February 2026 domestic violence incident, most likely will be suspended by the league before Week 1.
